description: Removal of front porch and addition of porch canopy, repainting of all facades, front hardstanding and associated works (RETROSPECTIVE).
decision_conditions: The retrospective painting of the front façade white would result in the erosion of the significance of the building's historic design, diminish the contribution of its brickwork to the streetscape, weaken the legibility of architectural details, and harm the wider visual coherence that is fundamental to the special interest of the Lakes Estate Conservation Area, resulting in 'moderate' net harm. This harm identified is not outweighed by any public benefits.  The proposal would be contrary to Section 20 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026); Policies D4 and HC1 of the London Plan (2021); CP31 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010); DMD37 and DMD44 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014); The Lakes Estate Conservation Area Character Appraisal and Management Plan; and, the Heritage Strategy (2019).
